name: AltVision – AI Alt Text Generator
author: Christopher State

sections.description:
AltVision uses advanced AI to automatically generate meaningful and descriptive alt text for your images, improving web accessibility and SEO.

Features:

  • One-click alt text generation
  • Seamless Gutenberg integration
  • Premium features for advanced users
  • Support for multiple image formats
  • Fast and reliable processing

External Services

This plugin uses external AI services to generate image alt text:

  1. Image Processing Service

– Purpose: Processes images to generate accurate alt text using AI
– Data Transmitted: Base64 encoded images and surrounding content for context
– Endpoint: https://cloudfare-worker-api.chris-172.workers.dev/proxy/process-simple-vision-api
– Frequency: When generating alt text for images in the editor
– Privacy Policy: https://altvision.cstate.se/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://altvision.cstate.se/terms

  1. Image Fetch Service

– Purpose: Securely fetches images for processing
– Data Transmitted: Image URLs
– Endpoint: https://cloudfare-worker-api.chris-172.workers.dev/proxy/fetch-image
– Frequency: When processing images
– Privacy Policy: https://altvision.cstate.se/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://altvision.cstate.se/terms
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/altvision-ai-alt-text-generator
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings->AltVision screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
How does the AI generate alt text?

The plugin uses advanced computer vision AI to analyze images and generate accurate descriptions.

Is there a limit to how many images I can process?

Free users can process X images per day. Premium users get unlimited processing.
